replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data to have a mean of zero and a standard deviation of one. Then, compute the covariance matrix to understand how variables relate to each other. Next, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues. The corresponding eigenvectors form the principal components. Project the original data onto these principal components to get the reduced data.
